name: ClimateZone - Default (seed v1)
description: A climate zone (production engine P3, #86; PRODUCTION_KINDS § 4.4): its weather is rolled once per in-game day and stored. Weather odds and the towns in the zone are edited in the web app's zone editor or through the API.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Which towns it is for and what its weather is like.

fields.label: Default zone
fields.description: The zone of every town without one. Exactly one zone is the default: making this one the default unsets the old one.
